_note: TEST-ONLY. unified_calendar: firelens.unified_calendar.build() on the real FIRMS yearly archives for 45N 10E (25 km). current_conditions: same code with a FAKE near-real-time client (no MAP_KEY available).

validation.method: leave-one-year-out over 2012-2021 (ratio refitted without the tested year)

unified_calendar.label: Harmonized by local MODIS–VIIRS calibration (experimental, not the FireLens regional model)
limitations: Location-level calibration: one MODIS/VIIRS ratio per disc, estimated on 2012-2021. It assumes the ratio is stable over time; it is not validated outside the overlap years.
Counts are satellite hotspot detections (pixels), not fires. MODIS (1 km) and VIIRS (375 m) see different fire sizes, so the ratio is an average conversion, not a per-fire match.
Years from the FIRMS yearly archives are treated as fully observed; FIRMS-listed missing days are not removed.
Only Aqua MODIS and S-NPP VIIRS are used (same afternoon overpass). S-NPP delivery ended on 2026-11-02.

season.definition: Onset = month when 10 % of a fire-year's detections are reached, end = 90 %, peak = busiest month; the fire-year starts at the calendar month with the least activity.

current_conditions.reference: S-NPP VIIRS, same calendar window, 2012 onwards
limitations: Different satellites carrying the same VIIRS instrument: NOAA-20 and S-NPP counts are comparable but not identical.
Near-real-time data may still change; the most recent day can be incomplete.
A count above the past range is unusual for this place, not a forecast of danger.
current_conditions.explanation: 1 detection in the last 14 days vs a median of 0 in the same window of 14 past years.
